notes.title: Lantern of Worlds - The Story of Layla 1.7 update!
notes.notes:
The 3rd game in the Lantern of Worlds series, Lantern of Worlds - The Story of Layla, has now been updated to version 1.7!

The new update contains:

- Choose your starting skills!

- Updated lighting

- improved skill screen.

Now, Layla is even better equipped to face the dangers of her adventure, and with your help, will surely win the day and become the Queen of Pirates!

The game is totally free, and can be found here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1047190/

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33706178/08f4a767b18e6a9f526e36980672afb0586b5540.jpg
